compositionGrammar.en: Planet function: {functionDefinition} Sign direction: {directionDefinition} Read together, {planetLabel} in {signLabel} describes that planetary function operating through this directional mode. This is a symbolic composition, not a personality fact, destiny claim, or guaranteed event.
compositionGrammar.zh-Hans: 行星功能：{functionDefinition} 星座方向：{directionDefinition} 合并阅读时，{planetLabel}落在{signLabel}表示该行星功能通过这一方向模式运行；这是象征性组合，不是人格事实、命运断言或必然事件。
